Thank you, Eric. I see the $1,750 deposit with transaction ID 7JK2831FZP763911W was credited to Hillside Clinic's account (billing@hillsideclinic.com) at 8:13 AM this morning.
Perfect. Will this clear my outstanding balance for the CT scan billed to patient ID HC-59137?
Yes, patient ID HC-59137 is now fully settled. The receipt will be sent to your registered email, eric.jensen@email.com, within the next hour for your records.
